tools.name: list_modules
tools.title: List SWMM5+ modules
tools.description: List all Fortran modules extracted from the SWMM5+ codebase, optionally filtered by subsystem. Every response includes a `provenance` envelope pinning the SWMM5+ revision and EPA runtime version (5.1.13).

tools.name: get_module
tools.title: Get SWMM5+ module details
tools.description: Return metadata for a single Fortran module: file path, subsystem, dependencies (use statements), and GitHub link. Response `structuredContent` includes a `provenance` envelope.

tools.name: search_modules
tools.title: Search SWMM5+ modules
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search over module id, name, and file path. Response includes a `provenance` envelope.

tools.name: list_papers
tools.title: List Hodges research papers
tools.description: List the curated Hodges (and collaborator) research papers that inform the SWMM5+ implementation. Response includes a `provenance` envelope.

subsystem.description: Optional subsystem id to filter related papers.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.title: Get Hodges paper details
tools.description: Return full metadata and direct links (DOI/URL) for a single curated Hodges research paper by id. Response includes a `provenance` envelope.

tools.name: fetch_module_source
tools.title: Fetch SWMM5+ module Fortran source
tools.description: Download the raw Fortran source of a SWMM5+ module from GitHub. Optionally truncate to a max character count. Response includes `provenance` and a `content_sha256` of the raw source.

maxChars.description: Truncate source to this many characters (default 40000).

tools.name: download_module_bundle
tools.title: Download SWMM5+ module bundle
tools.description: Return a zip (base64) containing the selected module's Fortran source and the sources of every in-repo module it transitively depends on via `use` statements, plus a MANIFEST.json listing the files.

includeTransitive.description: Include the full transitive `use` closure (default true). If false, only direct dependencies are included.
